set.body: Consumer: PLS Neuro bd-01M1SATXX7S8X4ZDQ217NH11ND. Upstream BIDS4s issue: bd-01M322P677C36J1E2T4Y6TABFF. Generalize the fMRI workflow compiler and DatasetRecipe from a single project root to the BIDS4s linked-project resolver. Header and artifact references, events, masks, and confounds must resolve through declared source/root linkage; masks and confounds must remain on the selected derivative producer/root. Preserve root and producer identity in run, analysis-unit, and catalog provenance so equal BIDS entities across roots cannot collide. Acceptance: deterministic fixtures cover raw plus external derivative, standalone derivative plus explicit raw source, competing same-name producers, reversed root declaration and filesystem order, forbidden cross-root companions, missing linkage, and refresh drift isolated to the selected root; existing single-root consumers remain source-compatible.
set.title: Compile linked BIDS roots through root-aware artifact resolution
